senses.gloss:
juhū
(‘sacrificial spoon’)
------------------------------------------
One of the spoons used to pour oblations into the consecrated fire in a Vedic sacrifice, the जुहू is made of the palāśa wood (bastard teak, Butea frondosa) and has a cup-shaped bowl at the end. It is held in the right hand.
All आज्य offerings (offerings of ghee) are to be done with the जुहू. It can also be used when no other implement is mentioned for pouring the offerings.
